subject: prd/feature-draft
statement: Authenticated operator approval, exact-head and digest checks, memory integrity, required CI, code-owner protection, stale native-review dismissal, and admin enforcement retain their behavior; local-git remains explicit and never satisfies a hosted approval fallback
rationale: Driver delegation must not silently remove the checks that make a reviewed version eligible to land
fit_criterion: Existing human, readiness, memory, and local receipt suites pass; the only added approval path requires the mainline driver grant and account; no protection or admin-bypass write exists.
